scope: first 10 candidates of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, original order; predictions not inspected
method_note: Eligibility criteria are judged from original cited sources, not FRDB flags or model predictions. FRDB Cmax values were read only after all predictions were sealed and used to map duplicate-dose row IDs to exact source-table cells; this mapping did not determine eligibility or select by prediction error. 'verified_with_caveat' means original Cmax is readable but at least one P0 criterion remains unresolved. 'unverified' means the original full text was inaccessible.

PubMed 16248851 (Curr Alzheimer Res 2005;2:483-92, DOI 10.2174/156720505774330564) has no PMC copy, Unpaywall shows no OA copy, publisher page (eurekaselect) behind Cloudflare challenge. Abstract/title state healthy elderly; age alone is not an exclusion. Full text is still needed for fasting, formulation, parent analyte, and the exact Cmax arm.

PubMed 10763459 is an Adis 'Drugs in R&D' drug profile (DOI 10.2165/00126839-199902060-00017), i.e., a secondary review, not a primary PK study; Springer page is paywalled (buy/subscribe). Original study, population, fasting and formulation cannot be verified.

review_status: AI-assisted source extraction draft; protocol eligibility not adjudicated; do not score
coordinator_note: The original Claude pass marked etamsylate fully verified, but its paper does not explicitly establish immediate-release status. Subsequent coordinator review corrected age-only exclusions: healthy elderly participants meet the adult criterion. No first-ten candidate is yet confirmed to satisfy every P0 criterion. Model predictions were not inspected during source review.
coordinator_correction: The P0 criterion healthy adult has no upper-age cutoff. Healthy elderly people are adults. The earlier age-only rejection of vapiprost and balofloxacin arms was erroneous; their original-study arms are now caveated for formulation/source issues rather than age. FRDB outcome values were used only to map duplicate-dose rows to original table columns, after predictions had been sealed and without inspecting predictions.
